name: yab
title: Yab
description: Search tabs, spaces and history in the Yab browser, and open tabs and windows.
author: fun_sai

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Yab
commands.description: Search open tabs and history, or search the web in Yab.

commands.name: search-tabs
commands.title: Search Tabs
commands.subtitle: Yab
commands.description: Search and switch to open Yab tabs.

commands.name: new-tab
commands.title: New Tab
commands.subtitle: Yab
commands.description: Open a new tab in the front Yab window.

commands.name: new-incognito-window
commands.title: New Incognito Window
commands.subtitle: Yab
commands.description: Open a new private Yab window.

commands.name: new-small-window
commands.title: New Small Window
commands.subtitle: Yab
commands.description: Open a Yab Small Window, with an optional address.

commands.name: open-url
commands.title: Open URL in Yab
commands.subtitle: Yab
commands.description: Open a URL in a new Yab tab. Uses the clipboard when empty, and searches the web when the text is not a URL.

preferences.name: searchEngine
preferences.title: Search Engine
preferences.description: Used when the text is not a URL.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
